author: independent education critic (read-only review) - transcribed faithfully from ~/claude/pep-deliverables/critics/spring-basics-lab-critic-education.json by the loop-3 recheck reviewer, 2026-11-19
summary: All 9 topics have a tested task (topics 1 and 2 only lightly via Tasks 7/4). Tasks are fairly faded; every required construct is taught. Starter has no solution leakage; tests are deterministic and match README wording. Placement after the last topic is correct and timing is labeled unpiloted. Defects are one mastery-layer reference and two small inaccuracies.

findings.claim: The module still lists assessments [spring-boot-basics-mastery-check] (lines 20-21), and the notes added at lines 29-30 name the mastery-check bank. The fixed hierarchy allows no module-mastery MCQ layer and the lab should not reference or depend on it.
findings.recommendation: Delete the line 29 note and the line 30 practice-mastery-check note. Clear the assessments array only if the brief allows touching the legacy link; otherwise record it as a separate retirement item.

findings.claim: README says each task has a TODO comment except Task 6, which creates a new file. This is wrong: Task 6 has a TODO in WorkshopController, adds a handler and a record in an existing file, and creates no file. Task 4 is the task that creates a file and has no TODO.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite as: Each task has a TODO comment, except Task 4, which creates a new file.

findings.claim: The javadoc says Task 7 makes Spring find AboutController. The scanning task is Task 5, so the comment misleads learners.

The timing note compares 102 required minutes (58+36+8) with 95 minutes described as the S2 page blocks plus a 40-minute lab block. The arithmetic is confusing and hard to audit, although the text correctly says the fit is unproven and unpiloted.
findings.recommendation: State the two totals plainly (page time plus lab plus setup versus the slot) and label the schedule decision open, with no derived figure.

findings.claim: spring-vs-spring-boot#o2 (BOM parent and starters) has no dedicated check. It is covered only by Task 7 starting the embedded server, so the coverage of topic 1 is thin, though the notes record it honestly.
findings.recommendation: Optionally add one line to Task 7 asking learners to find the parent and the starter in pom.xml, with no new test.
